dataset_provenance.holdout_label_assumption: Chronological rows after the 70% timestamp split are assumed normal because the input is the historical baseline; labels are not independently reviewed.

metric_scope.prediction_rule: Positive if detector returns any actionable candidate or informational deviation.

unavailable_checks.reason: A 19-row fit is below the active runtime minimum.
The active telemetry FEATURE_NAMES do not include available disk space; no disk prediction was fabricated.

gradual_drift_detection_delay.scope: Synthetic drift episodes only; no mapping to incident-level detection or response latency.

limitations: Synthetic and assumed labels do not establish live monitoring accuracy.
The baseline holdout and generated noise are assumed normal.
Static synthetic feature excursions are labeled positive by construction.
Point-level counts do not represent incident-level detection rates.
Only gradual-drift episodes have a modeled detection-delay origin.
Detection does not imply an incident, policy approval, execution, or recovery.
